information:
The competition will be at a different venue based on the day.

**Day 1 - May 25th**
[Chattahoochee Technical College (Paulding Campus)](http://www.chattahoocheetech.edu/)
Building B, Room B108
[400 Nathan Dean Blvd, 
Dallas, GA 30132](https://goo.gl/maps/aj86ne4FuRQ2)
Note: plugging the address directly into Google Maps will take you to Building A. Building B is across the street (see Venue tab).

**Day 2 - May 26th**
[Paulding County Senior Center](https://www.paulding.gov/203/Senior-Center)
Magnolia Room
[54 Industrial Way N, 
Dallas, GA 30132](https://goo.gl/maps/V1eFFghQiDN2)
Note: plugging the address directly into Google Maps will take you to the parking lot.
